record.title: Installation, authorization and update operations
record.contract: Installation/authentication/license entitlement, online/offline authorization, usage-data consent and telemetry, update/download/install/rollback, OS permissions and recovery remain required unknowns. SET-B003 is a source pointer and publisher licensing prose, not a new independently interpreted license contract.

record.title: Settings, help and media lifecycle
record.contract: Malformed/boundary input, unavailable content/device, cancel/undo/persistence/restart, focus/mapping conflicts, monitor/rate changes and teardown remain unknown.

record.setup_and_action: In a future separately authorized disposable OS setup retain installer identity, supported platform, permissions, failure/cancel and resulting files; this packet installs nothing.

Use an independently authorized test account/entitlement only in a separately authorized future investigation; enumerate online/offline/deauthorization/unavailable-network state and error transitions without publishing credentials.

Retain current and offered package versions, update/usage-data controls and explicit consent states; independently investigate cancel/restart/failure/rollback without assuming helper topology or applying an update.
Use offered zoom/theme/name/path bounds and invalid or unavailable paths in separate owned setups, recording clamp/reject policy without presupposing it.
Change a setting, lesson completion or Info Text and invoke Undo/Redo only where offered; record actual command availability and state.
Cancel an offered path/device/settings/content dialog separately and inspect retained settings and partial resources; no rollback policy is assumed.
Save/reopen two owned Sets, restart application and separately change user profile in an admitted setup; distinguish Set-specific Info Text from global preferences, content/progress and window state.
After positive available content/device/path baseline, remove only that dependency or connectivity and restore it; inspect reload/relink/fallback without a deadline.
Use text-edit focus, map mode, alternate keyboard layout and OS-reserved shortcuts separately; record routing/conflicts and screen-reader access rather than assuming global handling.

Change accepted audio rate, system output, window zoom and monitor scale separately while lesson playback and independently active Set audio are present; signal/glitch/latency comparator remains null.
Close lesson/PiP/Settings, Set and application during pending content load or offered settings operation in separate trials; retain prompts, playback and files without leak/cleanup claims.

meaning: Source-silent operational obligations remain U; generic labels/actions are not comprehensive lifecycle coverage.
